name: find_similar_issues
description: Search resolved issues for one that matches the problem the caller describes. Call before creating a new issue. Requires a verified caller. Returns at most one match with its resolution, or no match.

request_body_schema.description: Tool request body. conversation_id and caller_id are filled by the system, never by the model.

description.description: The caller's problem in their own words, 10 to 1000 characters.
